title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the globe appears as a sphere.

title: Understanding of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate an understanding of how the motion of the globe affects its appearance due to relativistic effects.

title: Use of Lorentz Contraction
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the concept of Lorentz contraction to the dimensions of the globe.

title: Light Propagation Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The response should include a discussion on how light from different points on the globe reaches the observer.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of relativistic formulas or misunderstanding of the observer's perspective.
